title: Disapointed!
text:
Disapointed!. So many good reviews, but I was disapointed with this popcorn air popper.

I bought organic popcorn from Trader Joe's which is a great popcorn.
But in this popper it looked good, but went flat when we started eating the popcorn!
It was Chewy, full of air, and did not have that crisp bite taste like the movie popcorn,or
the other type of popper that cooks on the stove.
Soooo Chewy it stuck to our teeth!

I returned this Poplite air corn popper.
I'm now thinking of buying the one that I would put on the stove, and turn the handle that
Amazon sells.

description: Pops with hot air, not oil, for a low-fat, heart-healthy treat! The PopLite® Plus hot air popper’s patent pending design provides enhanced performance. In test after test, the PopLite® Plus outpopped other leading hot air poppers making more popped corn with virtually no unpopped kernels. It pops up to 18 cups of gourmet corn in about 2 1/2 minutes, even faster than a microwave! The chute directs popcorn into your bowl so you can make batch after batch of all natural, delicious popcorn. Hot air popcorn is whole grain, a good source of fiber, and it’s faster, healthier, and more economical than most microwave bag popcorn. The popper is simple to operate with a push-button on/off switch. The built-in measuring cup/butter melter is close at hand when measuring corn for popping and features a metal insert for increased melting efficiency when used as a butter melter. Cleanup is a breeze because it pops without oil. Simply wipe the base and cover clean. The integrated cord wrap design provides convenient storage.
